page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with German glosses set in black letter after the Latin words. No margin notes. The running head is at the top, the page number at the top right, and a gathering signature below the last line at the right.

main_text.p: schnel. Sofpes, gesund. Sui, seiner. Superstes, nechwbe-rig / oder bey läben. Teres, rund in die lenge. Tu, du. Vetus, alt. Huc refer indeclinabilia, Ejusmodi, solch. Hujusmodi, solcherlei. Frugi, ein nützlicher. Nauci, verächtlich. Nihili, ein nichtiger. Nequam, schalckhafft. Quatuor, vier. Quinque, fünff. Sex, sechs. Septem, sieben. Octo, acht. Novem, neun. Decem, zehen. Undecim, eylff. Duodecim, zwölff. Tredecim, dreyzehen. Quatuordecim, vierzehen. Quindecim, fünffzehen. Sedecim, sechzehen. Septendecim, siebenzehen. Octodecim vel duodeviginti, achtzehen. Novendecim vel undeviginti, neunzehen. Viginti, zwentzig. Triginta, dreissig. Quadraginta, vierzig. Quinquaginta, fünfftzig. Sexaginta, sechzig. Septuaginta, siebentzig. Octoginta, achtzig. Nonaginta, neuntzig. Centum, hundert. Mille, tausent. Tot, so viel. Quot, wievil. A viginti ad centū minor numerus cum copula præcedit, vel sine copula sequitur: ut, unus & viginti, vel viginti unus.
Quædam Adjectiva sunt duarum vocum, quarum prior est generis communis, posterior generis neutrius: ut, hic, hæc fortis, hoc forte, starck. Hic, hæc doctior, hoc doctius, gelehrter.

Quædam Adjectiva sunt trium vocum, quarum prima est generis masculini. Secunda generis fœminini, tertia generis neutrius: ut, hic bonus, hæc bona, hoc bonum, gut. Hic amaturus, hæc amatura, hoc amaturum, der/die/das lieben wil. Hic amatus, hæc amata, hoc amatum, der/die/das geliebet ist. Hic a-mandus, hæc amanda, hoc amandum, der/die/das geliebet werden muß. Hic meus, hæc mea, hoc meum, mein. Hic noster, hæc nostra, hoc nostrum, unser. Hi ducenti, hæ ducentæ, hæc ducenta, zweyhundert. Tre centi, tæ, ta, dreyhundert. Quadringenti, tæ, ta, vierhundert. Quingenti, tæ, ta, fünffhundert. Sexcenti, tæ, ta, sechshundert. Septingenti, tæ, ta, siebenhundert.

page.notes: Black letter (Fraktur) German glosses are marked with bl; their exact spelling is as far as I could read it. "Lāben" was read as läben; "Tre centi" may be a printed split of Trecenti. Several German words in the first block, including "nechwbe-rig", "eylff" and "Tu, du.", are uncertain at the scan's resolution. No [?] markers were placed, but these readings are the least certain. The "Hic a-mandus" hyphen is printed. The superscript page number reads "41".
